* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following industry best practices
* Develop UI interfaces using React (hooks, functional components, context) with strong understanding of component composition, state management, and render lifecycle
* Define application infrastructure using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), primarily with Terraform
* Contribute hands\-on throughout the development lifecycle, with a focus on delivering high\-quality solutions
* Participate in technical discussions to share knowledge and contribute to solution design
* Maintain DevOps processes and deployment pipelines to support application releases and enhancements
* Support system migrations by refactoring legacy systems and modernizing applications using cloud\-native architectures
* Collaborate closely with product managers and UX designers to align engineering efforts with business goals and user needs
* Participate in product planning and roadmap discussions
* Take ownership of end\-to\-end feature development, from ideation through deployment and continuous improvement
* Leverage analytics and user feedback to enhance product functionality and experience
* Support and mentor team members through collaboration, code reviews, and sharing best practices
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment
* Responsibilities may evolve as needed


**Experience And Qualifications**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience developing full stack solutions, including use of build and deployment tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines)
* 5\+ years of backend API and application development using object\-oriented languages (Java, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript)
* 5\+ years of web application development (HTML, CSS, React, Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript)
* Strong understanding of AWS serverless services (S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge)
* Experience with cloud database services (DynamoDB, Snowflake)
* Experience with containerization (Snowpark Container Services, Docker, AWS ECS/Fargate)
* Experience with cloud build and deployment tools
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Serverless Framework, AWS CloudFormation, and Terraform
* Foundational knowledge of AWS cloud services and infrastructure
* Understanding of event\-driven and service\-oriented architectures
* Experience working in Agile environments
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with relational databases (DB2, Redshift) and data modeling concepts


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, management information systems, or a related field
* Equivalent professional experience will also be considered


**Certifications**
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Developer, DevOps) preferred
* Snowflake certification is a plus
